Harpreet Singh @ Ashu And Ors vs State Nct Of Delhi And Anr
on 24 December, 2025
 $~23
 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi

entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
+ Crl.M.C. 9278/2025
 Harpreet Singh @ Ashu And Ors

..... Petitioners
 Through: Mr. Sushil Kumar, Adv.

versus
 State Nct Of Delhi And Anr

..... Respondents
 Through: Ms. Kiran Bairwa, App for Sta
 S.I. Mahesh and H.C. Renuka, 
 Dwarka North.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vikas Mahajan
 Order

% 24.12.2025 CRL.M.A. 38712/2025 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. The present petition has been filed under Section 528 BNSS, 2023 seeking quashing of FIR No.0719/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at Police Station Dwarka North and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom on the ground that the parties have arrived at a settlement.

4. Mr. Sushil Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that the entire payment in terms of the settlement has already been made by petitioner no.1 [former husband] to respondent no.2 [former wife].
However, respondent no.2 is not coming forward and co- operating for quashing of the present FIR.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 25/12/2025 at 20:37:54 5.
In view of the above, issue notice.
6. Ms. Kiran Bairwa, learned APP appearing on behalf of respondent no.1/State accepts notice.
